hadiths.ar: إِنَّمَا الْأَعْمَالُ بِالنِّيَّاتِ، وَإِنَّمَا لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مَا نَوَى
hadiths.en: Actions are judged only by intentions, and every person will have only what they intended.

hadiths.ar: لَا يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يُحِبَّ لِأَخِيهِ مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ
hadiths.en: None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.

hadiths.ar: الْمُسْلِمُ مَنْ سَلِمَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ مِنْ لِسَانِهِ وَيَدِهِ
hadiths.en: The Muslim is the one from whose tongue and hand the Muslims are safe.

hadiths.ar: مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا أَوْ لِيَصْمُتْ
hadiths.en: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him speak good or remain silent.

hadiths.ar: اتَّقِ اللَّهَ حَيْثُمَا كُنْتَ، وَأَتْبِعِ السَّيِّئَةَ الْحَسَنَةَ تَمْحُهَا، وَخَالِقِ النَّاسَ بِخُلُقٍ حَسَنٍ
hadiths.en: Fear Allah wherever you are; follow a bad deed with a good one to erase it; and treat people with good character.

hadiths.ar: تَبَسُّمُكَ فِي وَجْهِ أَخِيكَ لَكَ صَدَقَةٌ
hadiths.en: Smiling in the face of your brother is charity.
